name: TopCustomersByRegion
description: The best customers of each region by revenue between two dates.

sql.*:
SELECT region, customer_id, revenue, place
FROM (
  SELECT c.region, c.id AS customer_id, SUM(i.total) AS revenue,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.region ORDER BY SUM(i.total) DESC) AS place
  FROM invoices i
  JOIN customers c ON c.id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.issued_on BETWEEN :fromDate AND :toDate
  GROUP BY c.region, c.id
) ranked
WHERE place <= :perRegion
sql.postgresql:
SELECT region, customer_id, revenue, place
FROM (
  SELECT c.region, c.id AS customer_id, SUM(i.total)::numeric(14,2) AS revenue,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.region ORDER BY SUM(i.total) DESC) AS place
  FROM invoices i
  JOIN customers c ON c.id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.issued_on BETWEEN :fromDate AND :toDate
  GROUP BY c.region, c.id
) ranked
WHERE place <= :perRegion
sql.sqlite:
SELECT region, customer_id, revenue, place
FROM (
  SELECT c.region, c.id AS customer_id, CAST(SUM(i.total) AS REAL) AS revenue,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.region ORDER BY SUM(i.total) DESC) AS place
  FROM invoices i
  JOIN customers c ON c.id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.issued_on BETWEEN :fromDate AND :toDate
  GROUP BY c.region, c.id
) ranked
WHERE place <= :perRegion

columns.name: revenue
columns.description: The customer's invoiced total in the period.

columns.name: place
columns.description: 1 for the region's best customer; ties share a place.
